args.command: echo '=== policy ==='; systemctl show zen-mini-chrome.service -p Restart -p ActiveState 2>/dev/null || true; export DISPLAY=:0; wmctrl -x -c 'google-chrome.Google-chrome' 2>/dev/null || wmctrl -c 'Google - Google Chrome' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 3; echo '=== after close ==='; systemctl show zen-mini-chrome.service -p Restart -p ActiveState 2>/dev/null || true; pgrep -a -u zenui -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome|google-chrome' | head -10 || true; echo '=== taskbar ==='; systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Close Chrome and verify it no longer reopens automatically
